text:
Splash into Friday night in Milton-Freewater
Published 3:30 pm Wednesday, June 17, 2026
MILTON-FREEWATER — Cool off and celebrate during Summer Splash, the upcoming Friday Nights on Main at Freewater Square, 417 N. Main St. The monthly event series, which features different themes, is hosted by the Milton-Freewater Chamber Downtown Alliance.
Bring a lawn chair and get ready to chill during the free family-friendly event on June 26, from 6-9 p.m. The Milton-Freewater Rural Fire Department will set up the splash zone with plenty of water activities to beat the heat. Bring your towels and sunscreen and be prepared to get wet.
In addition, the event features live music with Feedback, food and drink vendors, an ag equipment show and information booths with local nonprofits, service groups and government organizations. Also, shopping options include craft booths, local artisans and boutique retailers.
For more information, including a link to register as a vendor, search www.mfcda.org. For questions, call 541-938-5563 or email info@mfcda.org.
